C15 has related public-support machinery and a similar exhortative tone, while C10 shares the report-response form, but neither parallels the child as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I very much appreciate your report on the organization of the new peacetime USO.","parent_excerpt":"I am happy to receive the report of the Continuing Committee which clearly shows the progress made in fire prevention during the past year.","explanation":"Both open by warmly acknowledging a newly received organizational or program report."},{"child_excerpt":"it will have the complete backing of the Government... through our wholehearted support of the USO.","parent_excerpt":"It is indeed gratifying that so many organizations and individuals gave such wholehearted support to this cause.","explanation":"The distinctive phrase “wholehearted support” appears in both and is applied to broad backing for a voluntary public-service effort."},{"child_excerpt":"I wish the USO abundant success in its vitally important task.","parent_excerpt":"I personally feel that our battle against fire and fire hazards has only begun... all of you will continue to play an active role in supporting the programs","explanation":"Both conclude by stressing that the civic program remains important and encouraging its continued success or support."}]}
